catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class expresses the module's no-input deactivate/off action: cap.thermal.setpoint.v1 requires a target temperature and cap.device.configure.v1 requires a named parameter, while M18 turns off active thermal control and sets fan power 0.
catalogue_requests.summary: Deactivate the Temp Deck thermal system (M18): clear the target, disable the peltier and set fan power 0.

notes:
DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card names helper SerialDriver, but the confirmed entry symbol test_utils:Tempdeck is a host-side Python object with methods that speak the newline M-code protocol itself, and the M105.D and M103.D replies each carry several values in one line. The package is therefore a direct Driver over that class, with native.py as the hardware serial factory; the fake implements only methods the upstream class has. No wire syntax was changed: the same M105.D, M103.D, M104 S, M106 S and M18 lines are sent. The temperature target is Limit.operator_required because no text file of the clone states the operating range; site-limits.example.json shows an illustrative 4 to 95 Cel overlay, which is operator-supplied example data, not a device fact. The fake's peltier PWM after M104 is a placeholder proportional response to the target-minus-plate error (gain 1/100, clamped to -1 to 1) so the target write is observable in M103.D, as the firmware control loop makes it observable; the real PID response is not modelled, and all fake values are marked placeholder. Not covered by this package: PID constants (M301), thermal offsets (M116/M117), manual peltier PWM writes (M104.D), fan automatic mode (M107), dfu, and the PA1/PA2/HSA ADC fields of M105.D; the driver exposes the three thermistor temperatures, peltier current, fan speed, peltier and fan PWM, the manual fan PWM write, the M104 target action and the M18 safe-state action. No hardware backend was run and no hardware is attached; this package is model-authored and unreviewed (reviewed_by null), so the loader refuses its R2 hardware backend until a human signs. The clone has no LICENSE file: license_spdx NOASSERTION and license_class unknown are pinned as the card states.
